entities.summary: James Cornelius van Miltenburg O.F.M., also known as Alcuin van Miltenburg, was a Dutch prelate of the Catholic Church who was a missionary bishop in Pakistan, the first bishop of Karachi and of Hyderabad, Pakistan.
